_comment_secrets: Do NOT commit real credentials. Provide the connection string at runtime via the environment variable ConnectionStrings__NpgsqlConnection (or `dotnet user-secrets set ConnectionStrings:NpgsqlConnection ...` for local work). The placeholder below intentionally has no password and will fail to connect until overridden, which keeps developers from accidentally relying on a shared committed credential.
_comment_ssl: Ssl Mode=Require enforces TLS for all database connections even in development. The previous value (Prefer) silently falls back to plaintext if the server does not advertise TLS, exposing credentials on the network. Require ensures a secure connection is always established.
